content: Mwitegeere Mungu
Riihɨ ni iryʉmana bhɨnʉ bhɨrɨ gatɨ waanyu, bhɨrarwahe? Ndora bhɨrareetwa ni imyʉyʉ gɨnʉ gɨkʉhakaana mʉʉsi waanyu.
Muriigomba ebhegero, nawe hanʉ mʉkʉtama kobhona, muriita. Na mʉrarora ikiriiso, nawe hanʉ mʉkʉtama kobhebhona, mʉrʉʉmana na kwitana. Mʉtakobhona kɨnʉ mukwenda, kʉ kʉbha mʉtakʉsabha kwa Mungu.
Hanʉ mʉkʉsabha mʉtakobhona, kʉ kʉbha mʉrasabha kʉnzɨra ɨmbɨ, korereke mobhone kɨnʉ mukwenda kumyʉyʉ janyu.

Imwɨ, nɨ‑bhaatʉ bhanʉ mʉtaana bhoronge ncha abhasɨbhɨɨti. Nangʉ mʉtɨɨzɨ ʉkʉbha ʉmʉsaani wɨ ɨɨsɨ, nɨ‑kʉbha umubhisa wa Mungu? Mmbe, wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akwenda kʉbha ʉmʉsaani wɨ ɨɨsɨ, ahiikora kʉbha umubhisa wa Mungu.
Mutiiseega yandikirwɨ bhʉʉha mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu, ekoro yɨnʉ Mungu aatʉtɨɨrɨɨrɨ ɨrarora rihari bhʉkʉngʼu.
Nawe Mungu aratwongera ɨbhɨgʉngi, necho kigiriryɨ yandikirwɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu,
Mmbe, mwigwɨ Mungu na mwangɨ Shɨtaani, neho akʉbhangʼosa.
Mwisukɨku Mungu, neho wʉʉsi, akubhiisukaku. Imwɨ bhʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ na bha amiisɨɨgi abhɨrɨ, mutigɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwanyu na kokora amazʉmu, naatu mumutunɨ kozekoro zaanyu zʉʉsi.
Mwigwɨ ʉbhʉsʉngʉ, mʉrɨrɨ nu ukwarama. Ekeseko chanyu, kichurwɨ ɨkɨrɨrʉ, no obhozomerwa bhwanyu, bhʉbhɨ ʉbhʉsʉngʉ.
Mwiyichɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, newe araabhagungyɨ.
Mʉtabha muriigamba

Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, mʉtabha muriigobha, kʉ kʉbha wʉnʉ akogobha ʉmʉkɨndichazɨ, hamwɨ kʉmʉtɨnɨra, arabha agʉbhirɨ imigirʉ ja Mungu. Nawe ʉrɨɨtɨnɨrɨ imigirʉ, ʉtakʉbha mohocha wi imigirʉ, ʉrabha umutiniri wi imigirʉ.
Mungu umwene, newe akʉtʉʉra imigirʉ, na newe umutiniri wajʉ. Newe akʉtʉra kʉsabhʉra na kuricha. Nawe awɨ nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ, ʉratɨnɨra nyarʉbhɨri waazʉ?
Mutiikumya kʉganʉ mʉkɨɨrɨ kʉbha nagʉ
Nangʉ, munyiitegeerere bhwaheene, bhanʉ mukubhuga, “Reero hamwɨ tabhʉʉri, tʉraja ʉrʉbhɨri ororebhe. Na turiikara iyo umwaka mugima, tʉrakora ubhusuruja na kobhona esorobho.”
Nawe mʉtɨɨzɨ ganʉ gakʉhʉrʉka tabhʉʉri! Ubhwikari bhwazʉ nɨkɨ? Ndora bhwangɨ umwʉki, gʉrarorekana kwibhaga isuuhu, rogendo rʉmwɨ gʉrabhʉra!
Moreenderwa, mʉbhɨ mʉrabhuga, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ araasɨɨgɨ, tʉbhɨ bhahʉru tʉrakora kɨnʉ hamwɨ kirya.”
Nawe nangʉ imwɨ, muriikumya kʉganʉ mukwiseega kokora. Nu ukwikumya kuyo, nɨ‑kʉbhɨ.
Mmbe, wʉnʉ amɨnyirɨ kokora amazʉmu nawe atakokora, wuyo arakora ʉbhʉbhɨ.
